top.title: Asian Stocks Rise as Investors Shrug Off U.S. Tariff Plan
top.summary: Asian stock markets staged a major comeback after a selloff, as investors shrugged off new U.S. tariff proposals and Wall Street recouped most of the sharp losses ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.

top.title: Gold Edges Lower Amid Rate Hike Bets
top.summary: Gold edged lower in early Asian trade as U.S. inflation data reinforces expectations of further rate increases.

top.title: The Other Nvidia Romance With an Executive at a Company Linked to China
top.summary: Nvidia’s sales chief dated a Super Micro executive for years. Now they have married and her former company has been linked to chip smuggling.

top.title: Stocks advance in Asia after volatile US trading over AI risks
top.summary: Tech shares hit this month by fears over whether an AI boom can be sustained

top.title: Stocks Slump Again as Investors Fret About A.I., Tariffs and Inflation
top.summary: Nvidia and other tech companies fell as investors weighed developments in global trade and the path of interest rates.

top.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed as Nvidia, AI Rout Continues
top.summary: U.S. stocks finished mixed as the tech sector gave back more of the gains garnered in the wake of Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO.

top.title: Where the market may be mispricing risk most: AI boom, volatility, high-yield bonds
top.summary: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.
